while True:
    page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=None)

    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(page) if isinstance(page, list) else 'na', page)

    all_notes.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Show titles and ids
for n in all_notes:

# Prepare updated content for the bucket list note
note_id = bucket_note_id
old_content = note.get('content')
print('old_content snippet:', old_content.splitlines()[:15])

target = '[ ] Witnessing a total solar eclipse'
replacement = '[x] Witnessing a total solar eclipse'

if target not in old_content:
    raise ValueError('Target checkbox line not found in note content')

new_content = old_content.replace(target, replacement, 1)
print('new_content contains replacement:', replacement in new_content)

# Update the note content
update_res = apis.simple_note.update_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=simple_note_token, content=new_content)
print(update_res)

note_after = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=bucket_note_id, access_token=simple_note_token)
content_after = note_after.get('content','')
print('updated_title', note_after.get('title'))
print('has_done_checkbox', '[x] Witnessing a total solar eclipse' in content_after)
print('has_undone_checkbox', '[ ] Witnessing a total solar eclipse' in content_after)
# print the relevant lines
lines = content_after.splitlines()
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    if 'Witnessing a total solar eclipse' in l:
        print('line', i, l)
